name: Georg Schroth
headline: CTO / Co-Founder at NavVis - we are hiring!
summary: Georg Schroth is Chief Technology Officer and a NavVis Co-founder. He started the company based on his experience gained during his time at the Stanford Global Positioning Laboratory as well as the Stanford Information Systems Laboratory. He holds a Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering and Information Technology and graduated from the Center for Digital Technology and Management. At NavVis he is responsible for product strategy, management, and development.

positions.title: Co-Founder / Managing Director
positions.description: Bridging the gap between the physical and digital world, NavVis enables service providers and enterprises to capture and share the built environment as photorealistic digital twins. Our SLAM-based mobile mapping systems generate high-quality data with survey-grade accuracy at speed and scale. And with our digital factory solutions, users are equipped to make better operational decisions, boost productivity, streamline business processes, and improve profitability. Based in Munich, Germany, with offices in New York and Shanghai, NavVis has customers worldwide in the surveying, AEC, and manufacturing industries. For more information, visit www.navvis.com.

And our digital factory solutions enable greater organizational operability, productivity, agility, and profitability.
